I stand before you today to speak about one of the most common emotions experienced by humans, fear. Fear can hold us back from achieving our goals, making decisions, and living life to its fullest potential. But, it doesn't have to be this way. With the right mindset and tools, we can overcome our fears and live a life free of limitations.

The first step towards overcoming fear is to identify the root cause of it. By understanding what triggers our fears, we can begin to work towards addressing them. Once we have identified our fears, we can then start to take small steps to overcome them.

One powerful technique to overcome fear is to face it head-on. We must not allow our fears to control us. Instead, we need to confront them directly, even if it is uncomfortable. By pushing ourselves out of our comfort zones, we can slowly but surely diminish our fears.

Another effective technique is to shift our focus from our fears to our desired outcome. Visualizing success can help to boost our confidence and inspire us to keep pushing forward. We need to replace our negative self-talk with positive affirmations and remind ourselves of our strengths and capabilities.

It is important to understand that overcoming fear is not a one-time event. We must constantly work on ourselves and continue to push ourselves out of our comfort zones. It is through this continuous effort that we can slowly but surely conquer our fears.

Additionally, seeking support from others can help us overcome our fears. Surrounding ourselves with positive and supportive people who believe in us can make all the difference. Talking about our fears with someone we trust can help us gain a fresh perspective and feel less alone in our struggles.

In conclusion, fear is a natural emotion, but it should not limit our potential. By identifying our fears, facing them head-on, visualizing success, continuously working on ourselves, and seeking support from others, we can overcome our fears and live a life full of happiness and fulfillment. #define maxsize 100 //maximum string size will remain constant
void main() 
{
    char str[maxsize];
    int j,len,vowel,consonent;
    printf("enter a string:");
    gets(str);
    vowel=0;
    consonent=0;
    len=strlen(str);
    
    for(j=0;j<len;j++)
    {
        if((str[j]>='a'&& str[j]>='z')||(str[j]>='A'&&str[j]>='Z'))
        {
            switch(str[j])
            {
                case 'a':
                case 'e':
                case 'i':
                case 'o':
                case 'u':
                case 'A':
                case 'E':
                case 'I':
                case 'O':
                case 'U':
                vowel++;
                break;
                default:
                consonent++;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("Total number of vowels are =%d \n",vowel);
    printf("Total number of consonents are =%d \n",consonent);
}

05/05/2023, 8:00 pm - Dovansh: #include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>

int main() {
    int number, originalNumber, remainder, result = 0, n = 0;

    printf("Enter an integer: ");
    scanf("%d", &number);

    originalNumber = number;

    // count the number of digits
    while (originalNumber != 0) {
        originalNumber /= 10;
        ++n;
    }

    originalNumber = number;

    // compute the result
    while (originalNumber != 0) {
        remainder = originalNumber % 10;
        result += pow(remainder, n);
        originalNumber /= 10;
    }

    if (result == number)
        printf("%d is an Armstrong number.", number);
    else
        printf("%d is not an Armstrong number.", number);

    return 0;

29/05/2023, 9:53 pm - Amey Pacharkar: #include <stdio.h>
#include<math.h>

int Armstrong(int a)
{
    int n=0,result=0,b,c;
    b=a;
    while(b!=0)
    {
        b=b/10;
        n++;
    }
    b=a;
    while(b!=0)
    {
        c=b%10;
        result=result+pow(c,n);
        result=b/10;
    }
    if (result=a)
        return 1;
    else
        return 0;
}
void Armstronggenerate()
{
    int a;
    printf("The Armstrong numbers between 1 to 1000 are:\n");
    for(a=1;a<=1000;a++)
    {
        if(Armstrong(a))
        {
            printf("%d\n",a);
        }
    }
}
int main()
{
    int a;
    printf("Enter a number:");
    scanf("%d",&a);
    if(Armstrong(a))
    {
        printf("The given number is an Armstrong number");
    }
    else
    {
        printf("The given number is not an Armstrong number");
    }
    Armstronggenerate(a);
    return 0;
}0

05/06/2023, 8:25 pm - Amey Pacharkar: #include <stdio.h>

int main()
{
    int a[10][10],i,j,n,trans[10][10],temp;
    printf("Enter the order of matrix:");
    scanf("%d",&n);
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            printf("Enter the element of matrix:");
            scanf("%d",&a[i][j]);
        }
    }
    printf("Entered matrix is:\n");
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            printf("%d\t",a[i][j]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            trans[i][j]=a[j][i];
        }
    }
    printf("Transpose of given matrix is:\n");
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            printf("%d\t",trans[i][j]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
}

11/06/2023, 10:56 am - Dovansh: #include <stdio.h>

#define MAX_SIZE 100

void displayArray(int arr[], int size) {
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        printf("%d ", arr[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
}

int main() {
    int arr[MAX_SIZE];
    int size, choice;

    printf("Enter the number of elements in the array (maximum %d): ", MAX_SIZE);
    scanf("%d", &size);

    printf("Enter the elements of the array: ");
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &arr[i]);
    }

    printf("Enter the rotation choice (1 - Left, 2 - Right): ");
    scanf("%d", &choice);

    printf("Original array: ");
    displayArray(arr, size);

    if (choice == 1) {
        int temp = arr[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; i++) {
            arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
        }
        arr[size - 1] = temp;
        printf("Array after left rotation: ");
    } else if (choice == 2) {
        int temp = arr[size - 1];
        for (int i = size - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            arr[i] = arr[i - 1];
        }
        arr[0] = temp;
        printf("Array after right rotation: ");
    } else {
        printf("Invalid choice!\n");
        return 1;
    }

    displayArray(arr, size);

    return 0;
}

int main()
{
    int a[10][10],i,j,r,c,sum1,sum2; 
    printf("Enter the row and column of the matrix:");
    scanf("%d%d",&r,&c);
    for(i=0;i<r;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
            printf("Enter the element [i][j]:",i+1,j+1);
            scanf("%d",&a[i][j]);
        }
    }
    printf("The matrix is:\n");
    for(i=0;i<r;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
            printf("%d\t",a[i][j]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    }
    for(i=0;i<r;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
            if(i==j)
            {
                sum1=sum1+a[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    for(i=0;i<r;i++)
    {
        for(j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
            if(j==c-i-1)
            {
                sum2=sum2+a[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    printf("The sum of diagonal from left  is %d\n",sum1);
    printf("The sum of diagonal from right  is %d",sum2);
    return 0;

}

#include<string.h>
#include<ctype.h>
#include<math.h>    

int s[100]={0};
int top=-1,ch;

void push(int ele)
{
    if(top==99)
        printf("\nSTACK IS FULL\n");
    else
        {
            top++;
            s[top]=ele;
        }
}

int pop()
{
    if(top==-1)
        printf("\nSTACK IS EMPTY\n");
    else
        {
            ch=s[top];
            top--;
        }
    return ch;
}

void display()
{
    int i;
    printf("\nStack S=\n");
    for(i=0;i<=top;i++)
        printf("|  %d",s[i]);
}

void main()
{
    char postfix[100]={'\0'},ele;
    int i,n1,n2,result;
    printf("\nEnter postfix expression\n");
    scanf("%s",&postfix);
    printf("\nPOSTFIX EXPRESSION=%s",postfix);
    i=0;
    while(i<=strlen(postfix)-1)
    {
        ele=postfix[i];
        if(isdigit(ele))
        {
            push(ele-'0');
        }
        else
        {
            n1=pop();
            n2=pop();
            switch(ele)
            {
                case '^':
                    result=pow(n2,n1);
                    break;
                case '/':
                    result=n2/n1;
                    break;
                case '*':
                    result=n2*n1;
                    break;
                case '+':
                    result=n2+n1;
                    break;
                case '-':
                    result=n2-n1;
                    break;
            }
        push(result);
        }
        display();
        i++;
    }
    printf("\nResult=%d",pop());
}

char opr[25]={'\0'};

int topopr=-1;

char ch;

{
    if(topopr==24)
        printf("\noperator Stack is full");
    else
    {
        topopr++;
        opr[topopr]=ele;
    }
}

char popopr()
{
    if(topopr!=-1)
    {
        ch=opr[topopr];
        topopr--;
    }
    return ch;
}

char peepopr()
{

    return ch;
}


void displayopr()
{

        printf("|%c",opr[i]);
}


void pushout(char ele)

        printf("\n output Stack is full");
    else
    {
        topout++;
        out[topout]=ele;
    }
}

{

    for(i=0;i<=topout;i++)
        printf("|%c",out[i]);
}

{

    {
        case '^':
            return 3;
        case '*':
        case '/':
            return 2;
        case '+':
        case '-':
            return 1;
    }
    return -1;
}

07/08/2023, 9:18 pm - Dovansh: //C Program to convert infix expression to postfix using stack ADT.
#include <stdio.h>
#include<ctype.h>

#define SIZE 50            

char stack[SIZE];
int top=-1;       /* Global declarations */
int push(char elem)
{                       /* Function for PUSH operation */
    stack[++top]=elem;
}
 
char pop()
{                      /* Function for POP operation */
    return(stack[top--]);
}
 
int pr(char symbol)
{                 /* Function for precedence */
    
	if(symbol == '^')/* exponent operator, highest precedence*/
	{
		return(3);
	}
	else if(symbol == '*' || symbol == '/')
	{
		return(2);
	}
	else if(symbol == '+' || symbol == '-')          /* lowest precedence */
	{
		return(1);
	}
	else
	{
		return(0);
	}
}
  /* Main Program */
void main()
{                        
    char infix[50],postfix[50],ch,elem;
    int i=0,k=0;
    printf("Enter Infix Expression : ");
    scanf("%s",infix);
    push('#');
    while( (ch=infix[i++]) != '\0')
    {
        if( ch == '(') push(ch);
        else
            if(isalnum(ch)) postfix[k++]=ch;
            else
                if( ch == ')')
                {
                    while( stack[top] != '(')
                        postfix[k++]=pop();
                    elem=pop(); /* Remove ( */
                }
                else
                {       /* Operator */
                    while( pr(stack[top]) >= pr(ch) )
                        postfix[k++]=pop();
                    push(ch);
                }
    }
    while( stack[top] != '#')     /* Pop from stack till empty */
        postfix[k++]=pop();
    postfix[k]='\0';          /* Make postfix as valid string */
    printf("\nPostfix Expression =  %s\n",postfix);
}

10/08/2023, 9:13 pm - Amey Pacharkar: Example 1: Find covariance for following data set x = {2,5,6,8,9}, y = {4,3,7,5,6}

Solution:

Given data sets x = {2,5,6,8,9}, y = {4,3,7,5,6} and N = 5

Mean(x) = (2 + 5 + 6 + 8 + 9) / 5 

= 30 / 5

= 6

Mean(y) = (4 + 3 +7 + 5 + 6) / 5

= 25 / 5

= 5

Sample covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N - 1)

= [(2 - 6)(4 - 5) + (5 - 6)(3 - 5) + (6 - 6)(7 - 5) + (8 - 6)(5 - 5) + (9 - 6)(6 - 5)] / 5 - 1

= 4 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 3 / 4

= 9 / 4

= 2.25

Population covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N)

= [(2 - 6)(4 - 5) + (5 - 6)(3 - 5) + (6 - 6)(7 - 5) + (8 - 6)(5 - 5) + (9 - 6)(6 - 5)] / 5

= 4 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 3 / 

= 9 / 5

= 1.8

Answer: The sample covariance is 2.25 and the population covariance is 1.8.

Example 2: Using the covariance formula, find covariance for following data set x = {5,6,8,11,4,6}, y = {1,4,3,7,9,12}.

Given data sets x = {5,6,8,11,4,6}, y = {1,4,3,7,9,12} and N = 6

Mean(x) = (5 + 6 + 8 + 11 + 4 + 6) / 6 

= 40 / 6

= 6.67

Mean(y) = (1 + 4 + 3 + 7 + 9 + 12) / 6

= 36 / 6

= 6

Using sample covariance formula Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N - 1)

= - 0.4

Population covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N)

= - 0.33

Answer: The sample covariance is -0.4 and the population covariance is -0.33.

Example 3: Find covariance for following data set x = {13,15,17,18,19}, y = {10,11, 12,14,16} using the covariance formula.

Solution:

Given data sets x = {13,15,17,18,19}, y = {10,11,12,14,16} and N = 5

Mean(x) = (13 + 15 + 17 + 18 + 19) / 5 

= 82 / 5

= 16.4

Mean(y) = (10 + 11 +12 + 14 + 16) / 5

= 63 / 5

= 12.6

Sample covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N - 1)

= [(16.4 - 13)(12.6 - 10) + (16.4 - 15)(12.6 - 11) + (16.4 - 17)(12.6 - 12) + (16.4 - 18)(12.6 - 14) + (16.4 - 19)(12.6 - 16)] / 5 - 1

= (8.84 + 2.24 - 0.36 + 2.24 + 8.84) / 4

= 21.8 / 4

= 5.45

Population covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N)

= [(16.4 - 13)(12.6 - 10) + (16.4 - 15)(12.6 - 11) + (16.4 - 17)(12.6 - 12) + (16.4 - 18)(12.6 - 14) + (16.4 - 19)(12.6 - 16)] / 5

= (8.84 + 2.24 - 0.36 + 2.24 + 8.84) / 5

= 21.8 / 5

= 4.36

Answer: The sample covariance is 5.45 and the population covariance is 4.36.

#include<stdlib.h>
#include<graphics.h>
void main()
{
    int gdriver=DETECT,gmode;
    int x1,y1,x2,y2,i,step,xincr,yincr,dx,dy;
    initgraph(&gdriver,&gmode,"C:\\TURBOC3\\BGI");
    printf("\t\t********DDA LINE ALGORITHM********\n\n");
    printf("Enter the starting coordinates");
    scanf("%d%d",&x1,&y1);
    printf("Enter the ending coordinates");
    scanf("%d%d",&x2,&y2);
    dx=x2-x1;
    dy=y2-y1;
    if(abs(dx)>abs(dy))
    {
	step=abs(dx);
    }
    else
    {
	step=abs(dy);
    }
    xincr=dx/step;
    yincr=dy/step;
    for(i=1;i<=step;i++)
    {
	putpixel(x1,y1,15);
	delay(50);
	x1=x1+xincr;
	y1=y1+yincr;
    }
    getch();
    closegraph();
}

struct priority_queue{
    int ele;
    int priority;
}pq[4];
int rear=-1;

int isfull()
{
    if(rear==4)
        return 1;
    else
        return 0;
}

int isempty()
{
    if(rear==-1)
        return 1;
    else
        return 0;
}

void insert(int ele,int p)
{
    rear=rear+1;
    pq[rear].ele=ele;
    pq[rear].priority=p;
}

int gethighestpriority()
{
    int i,p=-1;
    if(!isempty())
    {
        for(i=0;i<=rear;i++)
        {
            if(pq[i].priority>p)
                p=pq[i].priority;
            
        }
    }
    return p;
}

int deletehighestpriority()
{
    int i,j,p,ele;
    p=gethighestpriority();
    for(i=0;i<=rear;i++)
    {
        if(pq[i].priority==p)
        {
            ele=pq[i].ele;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(i<rear)
    {
        for(j=i;j<=rear;j++)
        {
            pq[j].ele=pq[j+1].ele;
            pq[j].priority=pq[j+1].priority;
        }
    }
    rear--;
    return ele;
}

void display()
{
    int i;
    printf("\nPriority Queue:-\n");
    for(i=1;i<=rear;i++);
        printf("\n|ele=%d --- priority=%d|\n",pq[i].ele,pq[i].priority);
}

// {

int main()
{
    int ch,ele,p,m;
    do
    {
        printf("\n1.Insert\n2.gethighestpriority\n3.deletehighestpriority\n4.Display\n5.Peek\n6.Exit");
        printf("\nEnter your choice:-");
        scanf("%d",&ch);
        switch(ch)
        {
            case 1:
                if(isfull())
                    printf("Priority Queue is full");
                else
                {
                    printf("\n Enter Element:-");
                    scanf("%d",&ele);
                    printf("\n Enter Priority:-");
                    scanf("%d",&p);
                    insert(ele,p);
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                if(isempty())
                    printf("Priority Queue is Empty");
                else
                {
                    p=gethighestpriority();
                    printf("\nHighest priority is:-%d\n",p);
                }
                break;
            case 3:
                if(isempty())
                {
                    printf("Priority Queue is Empty");
                }
                else
                    ele=deletehighestpriority();
                printf("\n%d is Deleted",ele);
                
            case 4:
                if(isempty())
                    printf("Priority Queue is Empty");
                else
                    display();
                break;
            case 5:
            if(isempty())
                    printf("QUEUE IS EMPTY");
                else
                {
                    printf("%d",pq[rear].ele);
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    while(ch!=6);
}

class ArrayAddition
{
    public void Addition(int array[],int m)
    {
        
        int add=0;
        for(int i=0;i<=m;i++)
        {
          add=add+array[i];
        }
        System.out.print("\nthe Addition of all elements of the array is "+add+"\n\n");
    }
    public void display(int array[],int j)
    {
        int i=0;
        System.out.println("The array is :");
        while(i!=j)
        {
          System.out.print(array[i]+"  ");
          i++;
        }
    }
}

{
    public String Uppercase(String s)

        return s;
    }
    public String Lowercase(String s)
    {
        s=s.toLowerCase();
        return s;
    }
    public void Length(String s)
    {
        int a;
        a=s.length();
        System.out.println(a);
    }
    public String replace(String s)
    {
        String j,h;
        Scanner read= new Scanner(System.in); 
        System.out.println("String:"+s);
        System.out.print("Enter the word you want to change in the string: ");
        j =read.nextLine();
        System.out.print("Enter the word you want to change it to: ");
        h=read.nextLine();
        s=s.replace(j,h);
        return s;
    }
}

char queue[100];
int rear=-1,front=-1,n;

int isfull(){
    if(rear==n)
        return 1;
    else
        return 0;
}
int isempty(){
    if(front==-1)
        return 1;
    else
        return 0;
}
void enqueue(int ele){
    if(rear==-1)
        front++;
    rear++;
    queue[rear]=ele;
}
int dequeue(){
    int ele;
    ele=queue[front];
    front++;
    if(front>rear){
        front=-1;
        rear=-1;
    }
    return ele;
}
void display(){
    int i;
    printf("The Entered Queue is:\n");
    for(i=rear;i>=front;i--){
        printf("%d\t",queue[i]);
    }
}
int main()
{
    int ch,ele,i;
    printf("Enter the number of elements in queue:");
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("1.Enqueue\n2.Dequeue\n3.Display\n4.Exit\n");
    printf("Choose from above operations on Queue:");
    scanf("%d",&ch);
    for(i=0;i>=-1;i++){
        switch(ch){
            case 1:
                if(isfull())
                    printf("The queue is Overflowing\n");
                else{
                    printf("Enter the element:");
                    scanf("%d",&ele);
                    enqueue(ele);
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                if(isempty())
                    printf("The queue is Underflowing\n");
                else{
                    ele=dequeue();
                    printf("The deleted element from the queue is:");
                    printf("\n");
                }
                break;
            case 3:
                if(isempty())
                    printf("The queue is empty!!");
                else{
                    display();
                }
                break;
            case 4:
                printf("Thank you!!");
                return 0;
            default:
                printf("Invaid option choosen!!\nPlease select between (1-4) as follows:\n");
                break;
        }
    }
}

                        break;
                case 2:
                        p.toLowercase();
                        break;
                case 3:
                        p.charAt();
                        break;
                case 4:
                        p.Length();
                        break;
                case 5:
                        p.Replace();
                        break;
                case 6:
                        p.Intern();
                        break;
                 case 7:
                        System.out.println("Thank you");
                        System.exit(0);
                 default:
                        System.out.println("Please enter the current option:");
                        break;
           }
}

struct node{

void main(){
    struct node *head,*temp,*newnode;
    head=0;

        printf("Enter data:\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        if(head==0)

            head=temp=newnode;
        }

    }
    temp=head;
    while(temp!=0)

07/09/2023, 2:22 pm - Amey Pacharkar: #include <stdio.h>

//global variables
int dequeue[100];
int front = -1;
int rear = -1;
int n=0;

//function prototype
void enqueuefront();
void enqueuerear();
void dequeuefront();
void dequeuerear();
void display();
void getFront();
void getRear();

int main(){
    int choice,x;
    while(1){
        printf("1.Enqueue from Rear\n");
        printf("2.Enqueue from Front\n");
        printf("3.Dequeue from Front\n");
        printf("4.Dequeue from Rear\n");
        printf("5.Get the Front Element\n");
        printf("6.Get the Rear Element\n");
        printf("7.Display the Dequeue\n");
        printf("8.Exit\n");
        printf("Enter your choice:");
        scanf("%d",&choice);
        switch(choice){
            case 1:
                enqueuefront();
                break;
            case 2:
                enqueuerear();
                break;
            case 3:
                dequeuefront();
                break;
            case 4:
                dequeuerear();
                break;
            case 5:
                getFront();
                break;
            case 6:
                getRear();
                break;
            case 7:
                display();
                break;
            case 8:
                printf("Thank you");
                return 0;
            default:
                printf("\t\t\t!!!PLEASE ENTER CORRECT OPTION!!!\n");
        }
    }
}

//for entering an element via front of dequeue
void enqueuefront(){
    int x=0;
    //if dequeue is empty
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1){
        printf("Enter the number of elements in the Dequeue:");
        scanf("%d",&n);
        printf("Enter the element of the Dequeue:");
        scanf("%d",&x);
        front = rear = 0;
        dequeue[front] = x;
    }
    //if dequeue is full
    else if((front == 0 && rear == n-1) || (front == rear+1))
        printf("Overflow Condition\n");
    //if front is at 0 
    else if(front == 0){
        front = n-1;
        dequeue[front] = x;
    }
    else{
        front --;
        dequeue[front] = x;
    }
}

//for entering an element via rear of dequeue
void enqueuerear(){
    int x=0;
    //if dequeue is empty
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1){
        printf("Enter the number of elements in the Dequeue:");
        scanf("%d",&n);
        printf("Enter the element of the Dequeue:");
        scanf("%d",&x);
        front = rear = 0;
        dequeue[rear] = x;
    }
    //if dequeue is full
    else if((front == 0 && rear == n-1) || (front == rear+1))
        printf("Overflow Condition\n");
    //if rear is at 0 
    else if(rear == n-1){
        rear = 0;
        dequeue[rear] = x;
    }
    else{
        rear ++;
        dequeue[rear] = x;
    }
}

//deleting an element from front of dequeue
void dequeuefront(){
    //if queue is full
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1)
        printf("Underflow Condition\n");
    //if both are equal
    else if(front == rear){
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[front]);
        front = rear = -1;
    }
    //if front is at max 
    else if(front == n-1){
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[front]);
        front = 0;
    }
    else{
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[front]);
        front ++;
    }
}

//deleting an element from rear of dequeue
void dequeuerear(){
    //if queue is full
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1)
        printf("Underflow Condition\n");
    //if both are equal
    else if(front == rear){
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[rear]);
        front = rear = -1;
    }
    //if rear is at initialization 
    else if(rear == 0){
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[rear]);
        rear = n-1;
    }
    else{
        printf("The deleted element is: %d\n",dequeue[rear]);
        rear --;
    }
}

//to print the front element
void getFront(){
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1)
        printf("Underflow Condition\n");
    else
        printf("The front element is: %d\n",dequeue[front]);
}


//to print the rear element
void getRear(){
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1)
        printf("Underflow Condition\n");
    else
        printf("The rear element is: %d\n",dequeue[rear]);
}

//to display the  elements of dequeue
void display(){
    if(front == -1 && rear == -1)
        printf("Underflow Condition\n");
    int i = front;
    printf("The dequeue is:");
    while(i != rear){
        printf("%d\t",dequeue[i]);
        i = (i+1)%n;
    }
    printf("%d\n",dequeue[rear]);
}

struct node
{
    int data;
    struct node *pre;
    struct node *next;
};
struct node *head,*tail,*newnode,*prevnode,*nextnode,*cnode,*temp1,*temp;
int count;

void disfrstrt()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf(" Doubly Linked List Empty");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        while(temp!=0)
        {
            printf("|%d|--->",temp->data);
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        printf("\nNumber of nodes=%d\n\n",count);
    }
}

void create()
{
    int n,i;
    printf("Enter the number of data you want to input");
    scanf("\n%d",&n);
    for(i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data:\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        if(head==0)
        {
            head=tail=newnode;
        }
        else
        {
            tail->next=newnode;
            newnode->pre=tail;
            tail=newnode;
            
        }
        count++;
    }
    disfrstrt();
}

void disfrend()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf(" Doubly Linked List Empty");
    else
    {
        temp=tail;
        while(temp!=0)
        {
            printf("|%d|--->",temp->data);
            temp=temp->pre;
        }
        printf("\nNumber of nodes=%d\n\n",count);
    }
}

void insbeg()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf(" Doubly Linked List Empty");
    else
    {
        newnode=(struct node*)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        newnode->pre=0;
        printf("Enter the data:");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        head->pre=newnode;
        newnode->next=head;
        head=newnode;
        count++;
        disfrstrt();
    }
}

void insend()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf(" Doubly Linked List Empty");
    else
    {
        newnode=(struct node*)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter the data:");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        tail->next=newnode;
        newnode->pre=tail;
        tail=newnode;
        count++;
        disfrstrt();
    }
}

void insaft()
{
    int p,i=1;
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter position(After):\n");
        scanf("%d",&p);
        if(p>count)
            printf("Invalid position");
        else{
            temp=head;
            while(i<p)
            {
                temp=temp->next;
                i++;
            }
            printf("Enter data:\n");
            scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
            newnode->pre=temp;
            newnode->next=temp->next;
            temp->next=newnode;
            newnode->next->pre=newnode;
        }
        count++;
        disfrstrt();
    }
}

void insbef()
{
    int p,i=1;
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter position(After):\n");
        scanf("%d",&p);
        if(p>count)
            printf("Invalid position");
        else{
            temp=head;
            while(i<p-1)
            {
                temp=temp->next;
                i++;
            }
            printf("Enter data:\n");
            scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
            newnode->pre=temp;
            newnode->next=temp->next;
            temp->next=newnode;
            newnode->next->pre=newnode;
        }
        count++;
        disfrstrt();
    }
}

void delstrt()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        head=temp->next;
        printf("the deleted data is %d",temp->data);
        free(temp);
        temp=head;
        temp->pre=0;
    }
}

void delend()
{

    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        temp=tail;
        tail=temp->pre;
        printf("the deleted data is %d",temp->data);
        free(temp);
        temp=tail;
        tail->next=0;
    }
}

void delpos()
{
    int p,i=1;
    temp=head;
    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        printf("Enter the pos you want to delete:");
        scanf("%d",&p);
        if(p<1 || p>count)
            printf("Invalid position");
        else if(p==1)
            delstrt();
        else if(p==count)
            delend();
        else
        {
            while(i<p)
            {
                temp=temp->next;
                i++;
            }
        }
        temp1->pre->next=temp->next;
        temp1->next->pre=temp->pre;
        free(temp);
        
    }
    count--;
    disfrstrt();
    main();
}


void main()
{
    int ch;
    do{
        printf("\n\n******MENU******\n");
        printf("\n1.Create Linked List");
        printf("\n2.Display Linked List From Start");
        printf("\n3.Display Linked List From End");
        printf("\n4.Enter element at the beginning");
        printf("\n5.Enter element at the end");
        printf("\n6.Enter element after a node");
        printf("\n7.Enter element before a node");
        printf("\n8.Delete element at the beginning");
        printf("\n9.Delete element at the end");
        printf("\n10.Delete element from a specific location");
        printf("\n11.Reverse the node:");
        printf("\n12.EXIT\n");
        printf("\nEnter your Choice:\n");
        scanf("%d",&ch);
        switch(ch)
        {
            case 1:
                create();
                break;
            case 2:
                disfrstrt();
                break;
            case 3:
                disfrend();
                break;
            case 4:
                insbeg();
                break;
            case 5:
                insend();
                break;
            case 6:
                insaft();
                break;
            case 7:
                insbef();
                break;
            case 8:
                delstrt();
                break;
            case 9:
                delend();
                break;
            case 10:
                delpos();
                break;
        }
        
    }
    while(ch!=12);
}

    }
}

void delstrt()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        head=temp->next;

        free(temp);
        temp=head;
        temp->pre=0;
    }
}

void delend()
{

    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        temp=tail;
        tail=temp->pre;
        printf("the deleted data is %d",temp->data);
        free(temp);
        temp=tail;
        tail->next=0;
    }
}

void delpos()
{
    int p,i=1;
    temp=head;
    if(head==0)
        printf("Linked list empty");
    else
    {
        printf("Enter the pos you want to delete:");
        scanf("%d",&p);
        if(p<1 || p>count)
            printf("Invalid position");
        else
        {
            while(i<p)
            {
                temp=temp->next;
                i++;
            }
        }
        temp->pre->next=temp->next;
        temp->next->pre=temp->pre;
        free(temp);
        
    }
    count--;
    disfrstrt();
}

reverse()
{
    cnode=head;
    while(temp!=0)
    {
        nextnode=cnode->next;
        cnode->next=cnode->pre;
        cnode->pre=nextnode;
        cnode=nextnode;
    }
    cnode=head;
    head=tail;
    tail=cnode;
}

struct node{
    int data;
    struct node*next;
};
struct node *head,*temp,*newnode,*prevnode,*nextnode,*cnode;
int count;

void create()
{
    head=0;
    int i,n,choice=1;
    printf("Enter the number of nodes you want to enter:\n");
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("Creating a linked list.....\n");
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data:\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        if(head==0)
        {
            head=temp=newnode;
        }
        else
        {
            temp->next=newnode;
            temp=newnode;
        }
        count++;
    }
    display();
}

void display()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nLinked list empty\n");
    else{
        temp=head;
        printf("The Linked List is:\n");
        while(temp!=0)
        {
            printf("|%d|--->",temp->data);
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        printf("\nNumber of nodes=%d\n\n",count);
    }
}

void insertbegn()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data(Start):\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=head;
        head=newnode;
        count++;
        display();
    }
}

void insertend()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("\n");
        printf("Enter data(End):\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        temp=head;
        while(temp->next!=0)
        {
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        temp->next=newnode;
        count++;
        display();
    }
}

            newnode->next=temp->next;
            temp->next=newnode;
        }
        count++;
        display();
    }
}

{

            }

            newnode->next=temp->next;
            temp->next=newnode;
        }

        display();
    }
}

void deletestrt()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        head=head->next;
        free(temp);
    }
    count--;
    display();
}

void deleteend()
{
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        while(temp->next!=0)
        {
            prevnode=temp;
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        if(temp==head)
            head=0;
        else
            prevnode->next=0;
        free(temp);
        count--;
        display();
    }
}

void deletepos()
{
    int pos,i=1;
    if(head==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else
    {
        temp=head;
        printf("Enter the position:");
        scanf("%d",&pos);
        while(i<pos-1){
            temp=temp->next;
            i++;
        }
        nextnode=temp->next;
        temp->next=nextnode->next;
        free(nextnode);
        count--;
        display();
    }
}

void reverse()
{
    prevnode=0;
    cnode=nextnode=head;
    while(nextnode!=0)
    {
        nextnode=nextnode->next;
        cnode->next=prevnode;
        prevnode=cnode;
        cnode=nextnode;
    }
    head=prevnode;
    display();
}

        var budget = 0;
        var expenses = [];

        function setBudget() {
            var budgetInput = parseFloat(document.getElementById("budgetInput").value);
            if (!isNaN(budgetInput)) {
                budget = budgetInput;
                document.getElementById("budget").textContent = "Budget: $" + budget.toFixed(2);
            } else {
                alert("Invalid input. Please enter a valid number.");
            }
        }

        function addExpense() {
            var expenseInput = document.getElementById("expenseInput").value;
            var expense = parseFloat(expenseInput);
            
            if (expenseInput.toLowerCase() === "done") {
                return;
            }

            if (!isNaN(expense) ) {
                if (expense <= budget) {
                    expenses.push(expense);
                    budget -= expense;
                    updateExpenses();
                    document.getElementById("budget").textContent = "Budget: $" + budget.toFixed(2);
                    document.getElementById("expenseInput").value = "";
                } else {
                    alert("Expense exceeds the budget. Please enter a smaller amount.");
                }
            } else {
                alert("Invalid input. Please enter a valid number greater than 0.");
            }
        }

        function updateExpenses() {
            var expensesList = document.getElementById("expenses");
            expensesList.innerHTML = "";
            var totalExpenses = expenses.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
            document.getElementById("totalExpenses").textContent = "Total Expenses: $" + totalExpenses.toFixed(2);
        }
    </script>
</body>

        var budget = 0;
        var expenses = [];

        function setBudget() {
            var budgetInput = parseFloat(document.getElementById("budgetInput").value);
            if (!isNaN(budgetInput)) {
                budget = budgetInput;
                document.getElementById("budget").textContent = "Budget: $" + budget.toFixed(2);
            } else {
                alert("Invalid input. Please enter a valid number.");
            }
        }

        function addExpense() {
            var expenseInput = document.getElementById("expenseInput").value;
            var expense = parseFloat(expenseInput);
            
            if (expenseInput.toLowerCase() === "done") {
                return;
            }

            if (!isNaN(expense) ) {
                if (expense <= budget) {
                    expenses.push(expense);
                    budget -= expense;
                    updateExpenses();
                    document.getElementById("budget").textContent = "Budget: $" + budget.toFixed(2);
                    document.getElementById("expenseInput").value = "";
                } else {
                    alert("Expense exceeds the budget. Please enter a smaller amount.");
                }
            } else {
                alert("Invalid input. Please enter a valid number greater than 0.");
            }
        }

        function updateExpenses() {
            var expensesList = document.getElementById("expenses");
            expensesList.innerHTML = "";
            var totalExpenses = expenses.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
            document.getElementById("totalExpenses").textContent = "Total Expenses: $" + totalExpenses.toFixed(2);
        }
    </script>

class calculator

    }
    public int multiply(int a,int b)

    }
    public int divide(int a,int b)
    {
        return a/b;
    }  
     public int mod(int a,int b)
    {

    }

        System.out.println("5.MODULUS");
        System.out.println("6.EXIT");
        ch = sc.nextInt();
        switch(ch)
        {
            case 1:
                System.out.println("Addition is "+i+"+"+j+"="+cal.add(i,j));
                break;
            case 2:
                System.out.println("Subtracttion is "+i+"-"+j+"="+cal.subtract(i,j));
                break;
            case 3:
                System.out.println("Multiplication is "+i+"x"+j+"="+cal.multiply(i,j));
                break;
            case 4:
                System.out.println("Division is "+i+"/"+j+"="+cal.divide(i,j));
                break;
            case 5:
                System.out.println("Modulus is "+i+"%"+j+"="+cal.mod(i,j));
                break;
            default:


        }
        }
        while(ch!=6);
    }
}

#include<string.h>
#define MAX 20
#define true 1
#define false 0


int top = -1;
int stack[MAX];

/*Begin of push*/
char push(char item)
{
    if(top == (MAX-1))
        printf("Stack Overflow\n");
    else
    {
        top=top+1;
        stack[top] = item;
    }
}

/*Begin of pop*/
char pop()
{
    if(top == -1)
        printf("Stack Underflow\n");
    else
        return(stack[top--]);
}

main()
{
    char exp[MAX],temp;
    int i,valid=true;
    printf("Enter an algebraic expression : ");
    gets(exp);
    for(i=0;i<strlen(exp);i++)
    {
        if(exp[i]=='(' || exp[i]=='{' || exp[i]=='[')
        {
            push( exp[i] );
            printf("%c",exp[i]);
        }
        if(exp[i]==')' || exp[i]=='}' || exp[i]==']')
        {
            if(top == -1) /* stack empty */
                valid=false;
            else
            {
                temp=pop();
                if( exp[i]==')' && (temp=='{' || temp=='[') )
                valid=false;
                if( exp[i]=='}' && (temp=='(' || temp=='[') )
                valid=false;
                if( exp[i]==']' && (temp=='(' || temp=='{') )
                valid=false;
            }
        }
    }
    if(top>=0) /*stack not empty*/
        valid=false;
    if( valid==true )
        printf("Valid expression\n");
    else
        printf("Invalid expression\n");
}

struct node{
    int data;
    struct node*ll,*rl;
};

struct node * create()
{ 
    int x;
    struct node *newnode;
    newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
    printf("Enter Data(Enter -1 to exit):\n");
    scanf("%d",&x);
    if(x==-1)
        return 0;
    else
    {
        newnode->data=x;
        printf("Enter the left child %d:\n",x);
        newnode->ll=create();
        printf("Enter the right child %d:\n",x);
        newnode->rl=create();
    }
    return newnode;
}

void preorder(struct node * root)
{
    if(root==0)
        return;
    else
    {
        printf(" |%d| ",root->data);
        preorder(root->ll);
        preorder(root->rl);
    }
}

void inorder(struct node * root)
{
    if(root==0)
        return;
    else
    {
        inorder(root->ll);
        printf(" |%d| ",root->data);
        inorder(root->rl);
    }
}

void postorder(struct node * root)
{
    if(root==0)
        return;
    else
    {
        postorder(root->ll);
        postorder(root->rl);
        printf(" |%d| ",root->data);
    }
}

{
    struct node * root;
    int ch;

                printf("Preorder:\n");

}

struct node *head,*tail,*newnode,*prevnode,*nextnode,*cnode,*temp;
int count;


void create()
{
    int i,n,choice=1;
    printf("Enter the number of nodes you want to enter:\n");
    scanf("%d",&n);
    printf("Creating a linked list.....\n");
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data:\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=0;
        if(tail==0)
        {
            tail=newnode;
            tail->next=newnode;
        }
        else
        {
            newnode->next=tail->next;
            tail->next=newnode;
            tail=newnode;
        }
        count++;
    }
    display();
}

display()
{
    if(tail==0)
        printf("\nLinked list empty\n");
    else{
        temp=tail->next;
        
        printf("The Linked List is:\n");
        do
        {
            printf("|%d|--->",temp->data);
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        while(temp!=tail->next);
        printf("\nNumber of nodes=%d\n\n",count);
    }
}

void insbeg()
{
    int n;
    if(tail==0){
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
        printf("\nEnter 1 to create linked list 0 to options\n");
        scanf("%d",&n);
        if(n==1)
            create();
        else
            main();
    }
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data(Start):\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=tail->next;
        tail->next=newnode;
        count++;
        display();
        printf("1st node is:|%d|",tail->next->data);
    }
}

void insend()
{
    int n;
    if(tail==0){
        printf("\nLinked list not created yet\n");
        printf("\nEnter 1 to create linked list 0 to options\n");
        scanf("%d",&n);
        if(n==1)
            create();
        else
            main();
    }
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter data(END):\n");
        scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
        newnode->next=tail->next;
        tail->next=newnode;
        tail=newnode;
    }
    count++;
    display();
}

void inspos()
{
    int p,i=1;
    if(tail==0)
        printf("Linked list not created yet");
    else{
        newnode=(struct node *)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
        printf("Enter position:\n");
        scanf("%d",&p);
        if(p>count)
            printf("Invalid position");
        else{
            temp=tail->next;
            while(i<p-1)
            {
                temp=temp->next;
                i++;
            }
            printf("Enter data:\n");
            scanf("%d",&newnode->data);
            newnode->next=temp->next;
            temp->next=newnode;
        }
        count++;
        display();
    }
}

void delstrt()
{
    temp=tail->next;
    if(tail==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else if(temp->next==temp)
    {
        tail=0;
        free(temp);
    }
    else
    {
        tail->next=temp->next;
        free(temp);
    }
    count--;
    display();
}

void delend()
{
    int i=1;
    temp=tail->next;
    if(tail==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else if(temp->next==temp)
    {
        tail=0;
        free(temp);
    }
    else
    {
        while(temp->next!=tail->next){
            prevnode=temp;
            temp=temp->next;
        }
        prevnode->next=tail->next;
        tail=prevnode;
        free(temp);
    }
    count--;
    display();
}

void delpos()
{
    int pos,i=1;
    if(tail==0)
        printf("\nList Empty\n");
    else
    {
        temp=tail->next;
        printf("Enter the position:");
        scanf("%d",&pos);
        while(i<pos-1){
            temp=temp->next;
            i++;
        }
        nextnode=temp->next;
        temp->next=nextnode->next;
        free(nextnode);
        count--;
        display();
    }
}

void reverse()
{
    prevnode=0;
    cnode=nextnode=tail->next;
    while(nextnode!=0)
    {
        nextnode=nextnode->next;
        cnode->next=prevnode;
        prevnode=cnode;
        cnode=nextnode;
    }
    tail->next=prevnode;
    display();
}

{
    int ch;
    do{

        printf("\n10.EXIT\n");
        printf("\nEnter your Choice:\n");

        switch(ch)

#include <stdlib.h>

//initialise the structure
struct node{
    int data;
    struct node *next;
};

//initialise pointer
struct node *front = NULL,*rear = NULL,*temp, *newnode;

//function prototype
void enqueue();
void dequeue();
void peek();
void display();

int main(){
    int ch;
    while(1){
        printf("\n\nChoose your option:\n1.Enqueue\n2.Dequeue\n3.Peek\n4.Display\n5.Exit\nEnter your choice:");
        scanf("%d",&ch);
        switch(ch){
            case 1:
                enqueue();
                break;
            case 2:
                dequeue();
                break;
            case 3:
                peek();
                break;
            case 4:
                display();
                break;
            case 5:
                printf("Thank you!!!");
                return 0;
        }
    }
}

//to add elements in queue 
void enqueue(){
    newnode = (struct node*)malloc(sizeof(struct node));
    printf("Enter the data:");
    scanf("%d",&newnode -> data);
    newnode -> next = NULL;
    if(front == NULL && rear == NULL){
        front = newnode;
        rear = newnode;
    }else{
        rear -> next = newnode;
        rear = newnode;
    }
}

//to delete elements from queue
void dequeue(){
    if(front == NULL && rear == NULL){
        printf("Underflow Condition!!!");
    }else{
        temp = front;
        front = front -> next;
        printf("Deleted element is:%d",temp -> data);
        free(temp);
    }
}

//to peek
void peek(){
    if(front == NULL && rear == NULL){
        printf("Underflow Condition!!!");
    }else{
        printf("The number at front pointer is:%d",front -> data);
    }
}

//to display
void display(){
    if(front == NULL && rear == NULL){
        printf("Underflow Condition!!!");
    }else{
        temp = front;
        while(temp != NULL){
            printf("%d\t",temp -> data);
            temp = temp -> next;
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;


class factorial {
    public int Factorial(int n) {
        int i,result = 1;
        for ( i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            result *= i;
        }
        return result;
    }
}


class main {
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        int num,Result;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.print("Enter a number: ");
        num = sc.nextInt();


        factorial calculator = new factorial();
        Result = calculator.Factorial(num);


        System.out.println("Using iterative method:");
        System.out.println("Factorial of " + num + " is: " + Result);
    }
}




6.Factorial
import java.util.*;


class fibonacci
{
    public int Fibonacci(int n)
    {
        if (n <= 1)
        {
            return n;
        }
        else
        {
            return Fibonacci(n - 1) + Fibonacci(n - 2);
        }
    }
}
class Main
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        int fibNum,num;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.print("Enter a number: ");
        num = sc.nextInt();


        fibonacci calculator = new fibonacci();


        System.out.println("Fibonacci series up to " + num + ":");
        for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
        {
            fibNum = calculator.Fibonacci(i);
            System.out.print(fibNum + "||");
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;


class multiplicationtable
{
    public int Table(int t,int n)
    {
        return t*n;
    }
}
class Main
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        int num,m,i;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.print("Enter the number of which multiplication table you need:");
        m=sc.nextInt();
        multiplicationtable calculator = new multiplicationtable();
        for (i = 0; i <= 10; i++)
        {
            num = calculator.Table(m,i);
            System.out.println("|"+m+"x"+i+"="+num+"|");
            System.out.println("-----------");
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;


class calculator
{
    public int add(int a,int b)
    {
        return a+b;
    }
    public int subtract(int a,int b)
    {
        return a-b;
    }
    public int multiply(int a,int b)
    {
        return a*b;
    }
    public int divide(int a,int b)
    {
        return a/b;
    }  
     public int mod(int a,int b)
    {
        return a%b;
    }
}


class Main
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        int i,j,ch;
        calculator cal=new calculator();
        Scanner sc =new Scanner(System.in);
        do
        {
        System.out.print("Enter Two numbers a and b:");
        i = sc.nextInt();
        j = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println("Enter Operation");
        System.out.println("1.ADDITION:");
        System.out.println("2.SUBTRACTION:");
        System.out.println("3.MULTIPLICATION:");
        System.out.println("4.DIVISION");
        System.out.println("5.MODULUS");
        System.out.println("6.EXIT");
        ch = sc.nextInt();
        switch(ch)
        {
            case 1:
                System.out.println("Addition is "+i+"+"+j+"="+cal.add(i,j));
                break;
            case 2:
                System.out.println("Subtracttion is "+i+"-"+j+"="+cal.subtract(i,j));
                break;
            case 3:
                System.out.println("Multiplication is "+i+"x"+j+"="+cal.multiply(i,j));
                break;
            case 4:
                System.out.println("Division is "+i+"/"+j+"="+cal.divide(i,j));
                break;
            case 5:
                System.out.println("Modulus is "+i+"%"+j+"="+cal.mod(i,j));
                break;
            default:


        }
        }
        while(ch!=6);
    }
}

10.Constructor overloading:

import java.util.*;

public class Student {  
//instance variables of the class  
    int id;  
    String name;  
  
    Student(){  
        System.out.println("this a default constructor");  
    }  
  
    Student(int i, String n){  
        id = i;  
        name = n;  
    }  
  
    public static void main(String[] args) {  
    //object creation  
    Student s = new Student();  
    System.out.println("\nDefault Constructor values: \n");  
    System.out.println("Student Id : "+s.id + "\nStudent Name : "+s.name);  
  
    System.out.println("\nParameterized Constructor values: \n");  
    Student student = new Student(10, "David");  
    System.out.println("Student Id : "+student.id + "\nStudent Name : "+student.name);  
    }  
}

OUTPUT:
this a default constructor

Default Constructor values: 

Student Id : 0
Student Name : null

Parameterized Constructor values: 

Student Id : 10
Student Name : David

import java.util.*;


class ArrayAddition
{
    public void Addition(int array[],int m)
    {
       
        int add=0;
        for(int i=0;i<=m;i++)
        {
          add=add+array[i];
        }
        System.out.print("\nthe Addition of all elements of the array is "+add+"\n\n");
    }
    public void display(int array[],int j)
    {
        int i=0;
        System.out.println("The array is :");
        while(i!=j)
        {
          System.out.print(array[i]+"  ");
          i++;
        }
    }
}


class Main
{
    public static void main(String[] args )
    {
        int a[]=new int[100],i=0,n;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner (System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the number of elements in the array:");
        n=sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println("The number of elements in the array is:"+n);
        System.out.println("enter the elements of the array");
        while(i!=n)
        {
          a[i]=sc.nextInt();
          i++;
        }
        sc.close();
        ArrayAddition fill = new ArrayAddition ();
        fill.display(a,n);
        fill.Addition(a,n);
    }
}

import java.util.*;


class StringOpr
{
    public String Uppercase(String s)
    {
        s=s.toUpperCase();
        return s;
    }
    public String Lowercase(String s)
    {
        s=s.toLowerCase();
        return s;
    }
    public void Length(String s)
    {
        int a;
        a=s.length();
        System.out.println(a);
    }
    public String replace(String s)
    {
        String j,h;
        Scanner read= new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("String:"+s);
        System.out.print("Enter the word you want to change in the string: ");
        j =read.nextLine();
        System.out.print("Enter the word you want to change it to: ");
        h=read.nextLine();
        s=s.replace(j,h);
        return s;
    }
}


class Stringfunc {
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        String str;
        int ch;
        Scanner sc= new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("Enter a string: ");  
        str= sc.nextLine();
        StringOpr JAVA = new StringOpr ();
        do
        {
            System.out.println("***CHOOSE OPTION***");
            System.out.println("0.Print string");
            System.out.println("1.Change to upper case");
            System.out.println("2.Change to lower case");
            System.out.println("3.Check length");
            System.out.println("4.Edit input string");
            System.out.println("5.Check character");
            System.out.println("6.Exit");
            System.out.println("Choose from the above options:");
            ch=sc.nextInt();
            switch (ch)
            {
                case 0:
                    System.out.println(str);
                    break;
                case 1:
                    str=JAVA.Uppercase(str);
                    System.out.println(str);
                    break;
                case 2:
                    str=JAVA.Lowercase(str);
                    System.out.println(str);
                    break;
                case 3:
                    JAVA.Length(str);
                    break;
                case 4:
                    str=JAVA.replace(str);
                    System.out.println(str);
                    break;
                case 5:
                    int n;
                    System.out.println("Enter the position to find character");
                    n=sc.nextInt();
                    char g=str.charAt(n);
                    System.out.println("Character at position "+n+" is:"+g);
            }
        }
        while(ch!=6);
    }
}

#include<stdlib.h>
struct node
{
    int data;
    struct node *left;
    struct node *right;
}node;

struct node *insert(struct node *t,int key)
{
    if(t==NULL)
    {
        t=(struct node*)(malloc(sizeof(node)));
        t->data=key;
        t->left=NULL;
        t->right=NULL;
    }
    else
    {
        if(key>t->data)
            t->right=insert(t->right,key);
        else
            t->left=insert(t->left,key);
    }
    return(t);
}

struct node *search(struct node *t,int key)
{
    if(t==NULL)
        return(NULL);
    else if(t->data==key)
        return(t);
    else if(key>t->data)
        return(search(t->right,key));
    else
        return(search(t->left,key));
}
struct node *max(struct node *t)
{
    if(t==NULL)
        return(NULL);
    while(t->right!=NULL)
        t=t->right;
    return(t);
}
struct node *min(struct node *t)
{
    if(t==NULL)
        return(NULL);
    while(t->left!=NULL)
        t=t->left;
    return(t);
}
void preorder(struct node *temp)
{
    if(temp!=NULL)
    {
        printf("\n \n data: %d",temp->data);
        preorder(temp->left);
        preorder(temp->right);
    }
}
void postorder (struct node *temp)
{
    if(temp!=NULL)
    {
        postorder(temp->left);
        postorder(temp->right);
        printf("\n \n data: %d",temp->data);
    }
}
void inorder(struct node *temp)
{
    if(temp!=NULL)
    {
        postorder(temp->left);
        printf("\n \n data: %d",temp->data);
        postorder(temp->right);
    }
}
int main()
{
    struct node *root=NULL;
    struct node *temp=NULL;
    int c,key,n,i;
    do
    {
        printf("****MAIN MENU****");
        printf("\n  1.insert node \n  2.search \n  3.maximum number \n  4.minimum number \n  5.display in inorder format \n  6.display in postorfer format \n  7.display in preorder format\n  8.exit \n");
        printf("enter your choice:");
        scanf("%d",&c);
        switch(c)
        {
            case 1:
                printf("enter the number of data you want to enter:");
                scanf("%d",&n);
                for(i=0;i<n;i++)
                {
                    printf("enter data:");
                    scanf("%d",&key);
                    if(root==NULL)
                        root=insert(root,key);
                    else
                        temp=insert(root,key);
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                printf("enter key:");
                scanf("%d",&key);
                temp=search(root,key);
                if(temp!=NULL)
                    printf("%d found",key);
                else
                    printf("%d not found",key);
                break;
            case 3:
                temp=max(root);
                printf("\nmax=%d\n",temp->data);
                break;
            case 4:
                temp=min(root);
                printf("\nmin=%d\n",temp->data);
                break;
            case 5:
                inorder(root);
                break;
            case 6:
                postorder(root);
                break;
            case 7:
                preorder(root);
                break;
        }
    }
    while(c!=8);
    return 0;
}

#include <math.h>

int cf=0;

void lift(int choice)
{
    signed int diff;
    int i;
    diff=cf-choice;
    diff=abs(diff);
    if(choice<0)
        printf("INVALID");
    else if(choice==cf)
    {
        printf("You chose the same floor\n");
    }
    else if(choice>cf)
    {
        for(i=1;i<=diff;i++)
            cf++;
        if(diff>5)
            sleep(6);
        else
            sleep(3);
        printf("You are now on floor %d",cf);
    }
    else
    {
        for(i=1;i<=diff;i++)
            cf--;
        if(diff>5)
            sleep(6);
        else
            sleep(3);
        printf("You are now on floor %d",cf);
    }
}

int main()
{
    int chf;
    do
    {
        printf("\nYou are currently on floor %d Enter the floor you want to go to:\n",cf);
        printf("0   \n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("1    2\n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("3    4\n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("5    6\n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("7    8\n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("9    10\n");
        printf("\n");
        printf("Enter 20 if you reached your desired floor: \n");
        printf("\n");
        scanf("%d",&chf);
        if(chf!=20)
             lift(chf);
    }
    while(chf!=20);

    return 0;
}

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

// Structure for a node in the adjacency list
struct Node {
    int data;
    struct Node* next;
};

// Structure for the adjacency list
struct List {
    struct Node* head;
};

// Structure for a graph
struct Graph {
    int vertices;
    struct List* array;
};

// Create a new node
struct Node* createNode(int data) {
    struct Node* newNode = (struct Node*)malloc(sizeof(struct Node));
    newNode->data = data;
    newNode->next = NULL;
    return newNode;
}

// Create a graph with 'vertices' vertices
struct Graph* createGraph(int vertices) {
    struct Graph* graph = (struct Graph*)malloc(sizeof(struct Graph));
    graph->vertices = vertices;
    graph->array = (struct List*)malloc(vertices * sizeof(struct List));

    for (int i = 0; i < vertices; i++) {
        graph->array[i].head = NULL;
    }

    return graph;
}

// Add an edge to the graph
void addEdge(struct Graph* graph, int src, int dest) {
    struct Node* newNode = createNode(dest);
    newNode->next = graph->array[src].head;
    graph->array[src].head = newNode;

    newNode = createNode(src);
    newNode->next = graph->array[dest].head;
    graph->array[dest].head = newNode;
}

// Function to perform BFS
void BFS(struct Graph* graph, int start) {
    bool* visited = (bool*)malloc(graph->vertices * sizeof(bool));
    for (int i = 0; i < graph->vertices; i++) {
        visited[i] = false;
    }

    // Create a queue for BFS
    int* queue = (int*)malloc(graph->vertices * sizeof(int));
    int front = 0, rear = 0;

    visited[start] = true;
    queue[rear++] = start;

    printf("Breadth-First Search starting from vertex %d:\n", start);

    while (front < rear) {
        int current = queue[front++];
        printf("%d ", current);

        struct Node* temp = graph->array[current].head;
        while (temp) {
            int neighbor = temp->data;
            if (!visited[neighbor]) {
                visited[neighbor] = true;
                queue[rear++] = neighbor;
            }
            temp = temp->next;
        }
    }

    free(visited);
    free(queue);
    printf("\n");
}

// Recursive function for Depth-First Search
void DFSUtil(struct Graph* graph, int vertex, bool visited[]) {
    visited[vertex] = true;
    printf("%d ", vertex);

    struct Node* temp = graph->array[vertex].head;
    while (temp) {
        if (!visited[temp->data]) {
            DFSUtil(graph, temp->data, visited);
        }
        temp = temp->next;
    }
}

// Function to perform DFS
void DFS(struct Graph* graph, int start) {
    bool* visited = (bool*)malloc(graph->vertices * sizeof(bool));
    for (int i = 0; i < graph->vertices; i++) {
        visited[i] = false;
    }

    printf("Depth-First Search starting from vertex %d:\n", start);
    DFSUtil(graph, start, visited);
    printf("\n");

    free(visited);
}

int main() {
    int vertices, edges, src, dest, start;

    printf("Enter the number of vertices: ");
    scanf("%d", &vertices);

    struct Graph* graph = createGraph(vertices);

    printf("Enter the number of edges: ");
    scanf("%d", &edges);

    for (int i = 0; i < edges; i++) {
        printf("Enter edge (source destination): ");
        scanf("%d %d", &src, &dest);
        addEdge(graph, src, dest);
    }

    printf("Enter the starting vertex for traversal: ");
    scanf("%d", &start);

    BFS(graph, start);
    DFS(graph, start);

    return 0;
}

}

void party_name_input(int i) {
    newnode = (struct party*)malloc(sizeof(struct party));
    newnode -> next = NULL;
    printf("Enter the name of party %d: ", i);
    scanf("%s",&newnode -> name);
    newnode -> vote = 0; // Initialize vote count to 0
    if (head == NULL) {
        head = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    else {
        tail -> next = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    printf("Name registered!!!\n");
}

void print_name() {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nop; i++) {
        printf("%d. %s\n", i, temp -> name);
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
}

void give_vote(int ch) {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i < ch; i++) {
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
    temp -> vote ++;
}

void vote_ranking() {
    int swapped;
    lptr = NULL;

    if (head == NULL)
        return;
    do {
        swapped = 0;
        temp = head;
        while (temp -> next != lptr) {
            if (temp -> vote < temp -> next -> vote) {
                // Swap the parties
                tempParty = temp;
                temp = temp -> next;
                tempParty -> next = temp -> next;
                temp -> next = tempParty;
                if (tempParty == head)
                    head = temp;
                else {
                    pretemp -> next = temp;
                }
                swapped = 1;
            }
            pretemp = temp;
            temp = temp -> next;
        }
        lptr = temp;
    } while (swapped);
}

void vote_tie() {
    int ch;
    party1 = head;
    party2 = head -> next;

    printf("There is a TIE between %s and %s!!!\n", party1 -> name, party2 -> name);
    printf("Last Round between them!!!\n");

    while (1) {
        print_name(2);
        printf("3. Exit\n");
        printf("Enter your choice: ");
        scanf("%d", &ch);
        if (ch == 1) {
            give_vote(1);
        }
        else if (ch == 2) {
            give_vote(2);
        }
        else if (ch == 3) {
            break;
        }

        if (party1 -> vote > party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party1 -> name);
            break;
        }
        else if (party1 -> vote < party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party2   -> name);
            break;
        }
    }
}

int start_voting() {
    int ch;

        return nop;

}

}

struct party {
    char name[100];
    int vote;
    struct party* next;
};

// Initialize the variables of struct party
struct party* newnode, * head, * tail, * temp, *pretemp, *lptr, *tempParty, *party1, *party2;

//global variables
int v,at=0,attempts=3, nop;

// Function prototypes
void party_name_input(int i);
void print_name();
void give_vote(int ch);

int main() {
    // Initialization
    int  i, ch;
    head = NULL;
    tail = NULL;
    printf("\t\tELECTION SYSTEM!!!\n");
    printf("Log in before proceeding\n1.Admin Log in\n2.Voter Log in\nEnter your choice:");
    scanf("%d",&ch);
    switch(ch){
        case 1:
            admin_log_in();
            break;
        case 2:
            voter_log_in();
            break;
    }


    if (head -> vote == head -> next -> vote) {
        vote_tie();
    }else {
        printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", head->name);
    }

    return 0;
}

void party_name_input(int i) {
    newnode = (struct party*)malloc(sizeof(struct party));
    newnode -> next = NULL;
    printf("Enter the name of party %d: ", i);
    scanf("%s",&newnode -> name);
    newnode -> vote = 0; // Initialize vote count to 0
    if (head == NULL) {
        head = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    else {
        tail -> next = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    printf("Name registered!!!\n");
}

void print_name() {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nop; i++) {
        printf("%d. %s\n", i, temp -> name);
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
}

void give_vote(int ch) {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i < ch; i++) {
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
    temp -> vote ++;
}

void vote_ranking() {
    int swapped;
    lptr = NULL;

    if (head == NULL)
        return;
    do {
        swapped = 0;
        temp = head;
        while (temp -> next != lptr) {
            if (temp -> vote < temp -> next -> vote) {
                // Swap the parties
                tempParty = temp;
                temp = temp -> next;
                tempParty -> next = temp -> next;
                temp -> next = tempParty;
                if (tempParty == head)
                    head = temp;
                else {
                    pretemp -> next = temp;
                }
                swapped = 1;
            }
            pretemp = temp;
            temp = temp -> next;
        }
        lptr = temp;
    } while (swapped);
}

void vote_tie() {
    int ch;
    party1 = head;
    party2 = head -> next;

    printf("There is a TIE between %s and %s!!!\n", party1 -> name, party2 -> name);
    printf("Last Round between them!!!\n");

    while (1) {
        print_name(2);
        printf("3. Exit\n");
        printf("Enter your choice: ");
        scanf("%d", &ch);
        if (ch == 1) {
            give_vote(1);
        }
        else if (ch == 2) {
            give_vote(2);
        }
        else if (ch == 3) {
            break;
        }

        if (party1 -> vote > party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party1 -> name);
            break;
        }
        else if (party1 -> vote < party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party2   -> name);
            break;
        }
    }
}

int start_voting() {
    int ch;
    printf("\t\tSTART VOTING!!!\n");
    printf("The parties are:\n");
    print_name();
    printf("%d. Exit\n", (nop + 1));
    printf("Enter your choice: ");
    scanf("%d", &ch);
    if (ch == (nop + 1))
        return nop;
    give_vote(ch);
    printf("Your Vote has been Added!!!\n");
    start_voting();
}

void print_ranking() {
    temp = head;
    while (temp != NULL) {
        printf("%s == %d\n", temp -> name, temp -> vote);
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
}

int main() {
    // Initialization
    int  i, ch;
    head = NULL;
    tail = NULL;
    printf("\t\tELECTION SYSTEM!!!\n");
    do{
        printf("Log in before proceeding\n1.Admin Log in\n2.Voter Log in\n3.Exit\nEnter your choice:");

void party_name_input(int i) {
    newnode = (struct party*)malloc(sizeof(struct party));
    newnode -> next = NULL;
    printf("Enter the name of party %d: ", i);
    scanf("%s",&newnode -> name);
    newnode -> vote = 0; // Initialize vote count to 0
    if (head == NULL && tail == NULL) {
        head = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    else {
        tail -> next = newnode;
        tail = newnode;
    }
    printf("Name registered!!!\n");
}

void print_name() {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nop; i++) {
        printf("%d. %s\n", i, temp -> name);
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
}

void give_vote(int ch) {
    temp = head;
    for (int i = 1; i < ch; i++) {
        temp = temp -> next;
    }
    temp -> vote ++;
}

void vote_ranking() {
    int swapped;
    lptr = NULL;

    if (tail == NULL){
        printf("There are no Parties found to be ranked!!!!\n");
        return;
    }
    do {
        swapped = 0;
        temp = head;
        while (temp -> next != lptr) {
            if (temp -> vote < temp -> next -> vote) {
                // Swap the parties
                tempParty = temp;
                temp = temp -> next;
                tempParty -> next = temp -> next;
                temp -> next = tempParty;
                if (tempParty == head)
                    head = temp;
                else {
                    pretemp -> next = temp;
                }
                swapped = 1;
            }
            pretemp = temp;
            temp = temp -> next;
        }
        lptr = temp;
    } while (swapped);
}

void vote_tie() {
    int ch;
    party1 = head;
    party2 = head -> next;

    printf("There is a TIE between %s and %s!!!\n", party1 -> name, party2 -> name);
    printf("Last Round between them!!!\n");

    while (1) {
        print_name(2);
        printf("3. Exit\n");
        printf("Enter your choice: ");
        scanf("%d", &ch);
        if (ch == 1) {
            give_vote(1);
        }
        else if (ch == 2) {
            give_vote(2);
        }
        else if (ch == 3) {
            break;
        }

        if (party1 -> vote > party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party1 -> name);
            break;
        }
        else if (party1 -> vote < party2 -> vote) {
            printf("Congratulations!!! %s HAS WON THE ELECTIONS!!!\n", party2   -> name);
            break;
        }
    }
}

int start_voting() {
    int ch;
    printf("\t\tSTART VOTING!!!\n");
    printf("The parties are:\n");
    print_name();
    printf("%d. Exit\n", (nop + 1));
    printf("Enter your choice: ");

}

            at++;
            attempts--;
            while(at!=4)
            {
                c=wrongpass();
                if(c==1){
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(at==3)
            {
                timer();
            }
        }
        
    }
}

int wrongpass(){
    char ver[10];
    printf("Enter password:");
    scanf("%s",ver);
    if (strcmp(ver,"password") == 0){
        printf("\nThe password is correct:\nYou are logged in as the admin\n");
        at=10;
        attempts=0;
        admin_ascess();
        return 1;
    }
    else{
        printf("\nWRONG PASSWORD!!\nATTEMPTS REMAINING %d!!\n",attempts-1);
        at++;
        attempts--;
    }
}

void timer(){
    int l=1,t=1;
    do{
        if(l==1){
            printf("Invalid Entry LOGGING OUT.:");
            l++;
            t++;
            sleep(1);       
        }else if(l==2){
            printf("Invalid Entry LOGGING OUT..:");
            l++;
            t++;
            sleep(1);         
        }else if(l==3){
            printf("Invalid Entry LOGGING OUT...:");
            l++;
            t++;
            sleep(1); 
        }else if(l==4){
            printf("Invalid Entry LOGGING OUT....:");
            l++;
            t++;
            sleep(1);             
        }else if(l==5){
            printf("Invalid Entry LOGGING OUT.....:");
            l=1;
            t++;
            sleep(1); 
        }
    }while(t!=15);
    if(t==15)
        printf("LOGGED OUT!THANK YOU!!");
}

void admin_ascess(){
    int ch,i;
    do{
        printf("Welcome ADMIN!!!\nPlease choice what you  wish to do:\n1.Enter the party names\n2.Start Counting\n3.Declare Result\n4.Exit\nPlease Enter your choice:");
        scanf("%d",&ch);
        switch(ch){
            case 1:
                printf("Enter the number of parties participating in the election process:");
                scanf("%d", &nop);
                for (i = 1; i <= nop; i++) {
                    party_name_input(i);
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                vote_ranking();
                break;
            case 3:
                print_ranking();
                break;
        }
    }while(ch != 4);
}

void voter_log_in(){
    if(tail == NULL){
        printf("Welcome Voters!!!!\n");
        printf("There are no Parties to Vote for!!!\n");
    }else{
        printf("Welcome Voters!!!!\n");
        start_voting();
    }
}

class multiply{
    public static void main(String[] args){
        int a,result = 0,b;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println(" Enter the the two numbers which needs to be multiplied:");
        a = sc.nextInt();
        b = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < b; i ++){
            result = result + a;
        }
        System.out.println(" The result is "+result);
    }
}

int main(){
    int i,j,n,index,min,flag = 0;
    printf("Enter the number of elements in the array:");
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int array[n];
    printf("Enter the elements of array\n");
    for(i = 0; i < n; i ++){
        printf("Enter the element: ");
        scanf("%d",&array[i]);
    }
    printf("The given array is:\n");
    for(i = 0;i < n; i ++){
        printf("%d\t ",array[i]);
    }

    min = array[0];
    for(i = 0;i < n;i ++){
        for(j = i + 1;j < n;j ++){
            if(min > array[j]){
                flag = 1;
                min = array[j];
                index = j;
            }else{
                continue;
            }
        }
        if(flag == 1){
            array[index] = array[i];
            array[i] = min;
            min = array[i + 1];
        }else{
            min = array[i + 1];
        }
    }

    printf("The sorted array is:\n");
    for(i = 0;i < n; i ++){
        printf("%d\t ",array[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

public class BankApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
